title: Why did armed people come looking for Destiny's son? Kick streamer recalls frightening incident
summary_full: Kick streamer Destiny recounted terrifying experiences involving armed individuals near his home. He vividly described an alarming encounter where people brandished rifles and interrogated him about his son. Moreover, Destiny shared the ordeal of being swatted, leading to police unexpectedly storming his residence. These chilling incidents have profoundly shaped his view on online threats and harassment, affecting his family members as well, including his son and mother.
